# Modryos

> Modryos is a desktop studio for making Minecraft Java Edition mods without writing code. Models, textures, animations, creatures, items, recipes, machines, screens, quests and rules are made in one project, and Play opens the mod in the game. It is now in closed beta: request access at https://modryos.com/request-access.html. Testers get the download link in their invite email. Its price and licence are not announced.

Facts, as of 22 October 2026:

- Minecraft Java Edition versions: 1.21.1, 1.21.11, 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3.
- Loaders: NeoForge and Fabric, both from the same project.
- Also makes data packs and resource packs. It does not make Bedrock add-ons.
- Rules are written as sentences picked from a list; each sentence is Java underneath. A project can hold its own Java classes and mixins.
- Play starts the game with the mod, with one or two players on the same PC; many changes reach a running game without a restart.
- Runs on Windows.
- The first mod made with it is Goat Apples, on CurseForge.
- Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.

## Pages

- [Home](https://modryos.com/): what Modryos is, with pictures from the studio and the game
- [Features](https://modryos.com/features.html): each capability, how it is made in the studio and how it looks in the game
- [Questions and answers](https://modryos.com/faq.html): making mods without coding, Java, versions, loaders, Bedrock, price, release

## Docs

- [Modryos documentation](https://modryos.com/docs/): How to use Modryos, the desktop studio for making Minecraft Java mods without writing code.
- [Editors](https://modryos.com/docs/editors): Every editor in the studio, grouped as New thing groups them.
- [Advancement editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-advancement): One of the game's own advancements: a goal with a toast, reached by an item, a kill or a rule.
- [Animation editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-animation): How a model moves over time.
- [Another mod editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-dependency): A mod this one uses or works with, such as a recipe viewer: compiled against, in the test game, and named in both manifests.
- [Area value editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-areaValue): A number the world keeps by place, not by player or item: an aura in each chunk, an oil reservoir under it, radiation, a corruption that spreads, a pollution.
- [Armor trim editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-armourTrim): A trim put on armor at the smithing table, in any of the game's materials.
- [Attribute editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-attribute): A number every living thing has, as luck and armor are.
- [Banner pattern editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-bannerPattern): A pattern woven on a banner in the loom, and shown on a shield.
- [Behavior editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-behaviour): What happens when something happens: when this sword hits, set the target on fire.
- [Biome editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-biome): A region of the world with its own look and life.
- [Block editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-block): Something placed in the world: ore, stone, a crate.
- [Boat editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-boat): A boat or a raft a player rows on water, with a chest or not.
- [Caves editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-carver): Caves, ravines or Nether tunnels the world cuts into its ground.
- [Chest menu editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-chestMenu): A chest's screen of items, one to six rows of nine, opened by a rule for one player; each item runs its own lines when clicked, and nothing can be taken from it.
- [Code editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-code): A Java class of your own, kept safe when the mod is rebuilt.
- [Command editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-command): A command typed in chat with a slash, whose rules run when a player types it.
- [Commands to run editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-function): A list of the game's commands run together by name, when a world loads, or every tick.
- [Condition editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-condition): A test in plain words, like half of the time, only in a biome, only at night.
- [Creative tab editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-creativeTab): A tab of the creative inventory with the things you put in it, or your things added to one of the game's tabs.
- [Custom kind editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-matter): A matter of your own beside energy and fluid: a chemical, mana, heat, whatever your mod calls it.
- [Damage change editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-damageChange): A hurt a living thing takes, changed or cancelled by who takes it, who deals it and what it is, on every game version, without code of yours inside the game's own.
- [Damage type editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-damageType): A way of getting hurt, with its own message.
- [Dimension editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-dimension): A whole other world reached through a portal.
- [Drawing in the world editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-worldDraw): Drawn in the world from what the player looks at: an outline, the vein a key will break, a beam from the hand.
- [Drop editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-drop): What falls out when a block breaks or a mob dies.
- [Effect editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-effect): Something that happens to a mob for a while.
- [Enchantment editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-enchantment): A power added to a tool or weapon.
- [Extras for an item editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-itemExtras): What any item, the game's or yours, also does: composts, burns in a furnace, or what a dispenser does with it.
- [Feature editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-feature): Something the world grows as it is made: a patch of flowers, a tree, a boulder, a lake, a vein of a block.
- [File of your own editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-ownFile): Any file the mod ships as it is, under resources/: data, assets, anything the game reads.
- [Fluid editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-fluid): A liquid that flows in the world and fills a bucket, as water does.
- [Forms for every material editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-formSet): Makes a dust, a plate, a gear or any other form for every metal and gem the game has when it starts, other mods too.
- [Game rule editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-gameRule): A rule of the world, set with the gamerule command.
- [Game thing changed editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-gameChange): One of the game's own blocks, items or mobs given new values, such as a block's hardness, an item's stack size or a mob's health, a structure the game makes no more, or a limit the game sets, such as the anvil's most cost.
- [Gene editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-gene): A trait any thing can carry and pass to its young: a number such as Growth, or one of a few choices such as Coat colour.
- [Guide book editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-guideBook): A book of pages about the mod: words, pictures, items and recipes.
- [HUD drawing in code editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-hudDraw): Your own code that draws on the HUD every frame, in a box you place on the screen.
- [HUD number bar editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-hud): One number of the player shown over the game as a bar or words, like saturation above the hunger bar.
- [Item editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-item): Something held in the hand or kept in a chest.
- [Item change editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-itemChange): What happens to an item after it is made: its count, its wear, a name, a lore line, a random enchantment.
- [Key binding editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-keyBinding): A key players press to do something of yours.
- [Locks editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-locks): What a player may not use, wear, break, place, hit, enter or ride until they reach a skill level, a value or an advancement.
- [Loot changed editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-lootChange): What the game's own blocks, mobs and chests drop, changed in place: things taken out, or one thing given in place of another.
- [Loot table editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-lootTable): A weighted list of what can come out, rolled by a quest, a crate, a mob's or a block's drop, or a rule.
- [Machine recipe editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-machineRecipe): What one machine of yours turns into something else, and what it costs.
- [Material editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-material): What parts are cut from, any item the game's iron ingot among them: its color, and the numbers and abilities it gives a part.
- [Mob editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-creature): A living thing with a model, animations and behavior.
- [Mob behaviour editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-mobBehaviour): A piece of your own code that joins one activity of a mob's brain, the game's or another mod's.
- [Mod settings editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-configValue): A setting players can change after the mod is built, in its config file: a number, on or off, one word out of a list, or a list of entries they edit.
- [Model editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-model): The shape of a block, item or mob, made from boxes.
- [Movement editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-movement): How a living thing moves, the player or a mob: its speed and its jump, and a class of yours run as it moves.
- [Other mod's recipe editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-modRecipe): A recipe for a machine from a mod yours builds on, filled in by clicks.
- [Painting editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-painting): A picture hung on a wall.
- [Particle editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-particle): Sparks, smoke, dust and the like.
- [Potion editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-potion): A drink that gives an effect.
- [Projectile editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-projectile): A thing that flies, drawn by a model: a spell, a dart, a boomerang, a homing missile.
- [Quests editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-questBook): Chapters of quests a player finishes for rewards, read in a book of the mod's own, each quest placed on its chapter's page.
- [Recipe editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-recipe): Make something in a crafting table, furnace, stonecutter or smithing table.
- [Recipe change editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-recipeChange): Change a recipe the game or another mod already has.
- [Recipes taken away editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-recipesRemoved): Take recipes the game has out of the game.
- [Ritual editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-ritual): Offerings on pedestals around an altar, a catalyst on the altar, the conditions it asks, and the result it leaves on the altar.
- [Satellite editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-satellite): A launched thing that watches a place and reports back.
- [Screen editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-screen): A screen of the mod's own, laid out by dragging: opened by a rule, or shown always over the game.
- [Skill editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-skill): A skill with levels, like Mining or Farming: XP comes from any moment, each level reached runs its rewards, and locks may wait for a level.
- [Skill tree editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-skillTree): Skills a player buys with points, each after the ones it needs.
- [Sound editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-sound): A sound the game plays.
- [Space station editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-spaceStation): A built place in a dimension of its own that anyone or any vehicle docks with, orbiting a world at a height that rules move.
- [Species editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-species): A kind of bee, plant or animal: the gene values it starts with, what it looks like as a block, an item or a mob, and which two species bred give it.
- [Spell editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-spell): A spell of its own: what it does as rules (when it is cast, when it reaches a mob or a block, every tick it is kept up), what it costs (mana or any value), its cooldown and charge-up, and how it reaches: on the caster, along a ray, as a missile or all around.
- [Station recipe editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-stationRecipe): A recipe done on a station's own screen, with cells, tanks and energy.
- [Structure editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-structure): A building or ruin placed in the world.
- [Tag editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-tag): A named group of blocks or items other rules can point at.
- [Texture editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-texture): The pixels a block, item or mob wears.
- [The player editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-player): The game's own player: its body, and rules for its moments, such as when it eats, is hurt or joins.
- [Thing editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-thing): Something in the world that is not a mob and does not fly: a spell's ward, a frame on a wall, a floating orb, a balloon on a string, a trap.
- [Tooltip lines editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-tooltip): Lines added to the tooltip of any item or block, the mod's or the game's, or of every item, each filled in from the item's numbers and values and shown by its own condition.
- [Translation editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-translation): The names of your things in another language.
- [Value editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-value): A number or a list kept by an item, the player, a team or the world: Energy, XP, Kills, the foods a player has eaten.
- [Vehicle editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-vehicle): Something to ride that is not alive, beyond the boat: a cart, a motor boat, a broom or an airship, a minecart of its own, a ride along a path.
- [Villager job editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-villagerProfession): A job a villager takes at its workstation, with its coat and its trades.
- [Villager trade editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-villagerTrade): What a villager offers and asks for.
- [When fluids meet editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-fluidReactions): What happens where a fluid meets another fluid or a block: lava meeting water makes obsidian, your own fluid meeting lava makes a block or drops an item.
- [Word of your own editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-ownWord): A few lines you name once and use in any rule as one line: it is given as many things as it needs, and it can give back an answer.
- [World event editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-worldEvent): Something that happens to a whole dimension for a while: a blood sky, a fog bank, an aurora, a rift.
- [World type editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-worldType): A choice on the game's Create New World screen.
- [Worn slots editor](https://modryos.com/docs/editor-wornSlots): Slots you name on any mob, the game's own or yours: a hat on a cow, boots on its four legs, a saddle on a pig, armor on a wolf.
- [Things you can make](https://modryos.com/docs/things): Every kind of thing in the New thing dialog, by category.
- [Access point](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-accessPoint): A block that gives wireless items a range to its network.
- [Access transformer (NeoForge)](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-accessTransformer): Opens members the game keeps private, on NeoForge.
- [Access widener (Fabric)](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-accessWidener): Opens members the game keeps private, on Fabric, in the game's own names.
- [Advancement](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-advancement): One of the game's own advancements: a goal with a toast, reached by an item, a kill or a rule.
- [Aiming block](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-aimingBlock): A block that keeps a target place: a launcher's, a gate's other end.
- [Altar](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-altar): A block that performs rituals with offerings on pedestals around it, formed while a ring of gold blocks lies around it; say in its rules what forming does: summon, teleport, give, open a portal.
- [Animation](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-animation): How a model moves over time.
- [Another mod](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-dependency): A mod this one uses or works with, such as a recipe viewer: compiled against, in the test game, and named in both manifests.
- [Area value](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-areaValue): A number the world keeps by place, not by player or item: an aura in each chunk, an oil reservoir under it, radiation, a corruption that spreads, a pollution.
- [Armor](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-armour): Something worn that protects.
- [Armor trim](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-armourTrim): A trim put on armor at the smithing table, in any of the game's materials.
- [Asking chest](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-askingChest): A chest that keeps itself stocked from the storage network or by couriers.
- [Assembly station](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-assemblyStation): A block with a screen where a player fits, tunes, mends, names and takes apart the tool in their hand.
- [Attribute](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-attribute): A number every living thing has, as luck and armor are.
- [Backpack](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-backpack): An item with slots of its own, opened from the hand.
- [Bag of pieces](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-bitBag): A bag that keeps the small pieces a carving tool takes away, by look, and gives them back when pieces are added.
- [Banner pattern](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-bannerPattern): A pattern woven on a banner in the loom, and shown on a shield.
- [Battery](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-battery): An item that keeps energy: charged in a machine, it charges the tools and armour a player carries, and powers a machine it is put in.
- [Behavior](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-behaviour): What happens when something happens: when this sword hits, set the target on fire.
- [Berry bush](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-berryBush): A block that ripens in a minute in the light and gives berries when a player picks it, then grows again.
- [Biome](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-biome): A region of the world with its own look and life.
- [Block](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-block): Something placed in the world: ore, stone, a crate.
- [Boat](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-boat): A boat or a raft a player rows on water, with a chest or not.
- [Boss](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-boss): A hostile mob with a boss bar, special moves and a phase it enters when it is badly hurt.
- [Bow](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-bow): The game's own bow, drawn and let go, to change: how long it draws, how hard and how fast what it shoots flies.
- [Building plan](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-buildingPlan): An item that copies the blocks between two corners and builds the copy again wherever it is used, a few blocks a second, from the player's items.
- [Building tool](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-builder): Places a square of blocks at once where it is used, a ghost of them shown first.
- [Building wand](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-buildingWand): A wand that lays a line, a wall or a box of blocks from a corner a player marks to the block it is used on, outlining it first.
- [Cable](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-cable): Carries energy between machines.
- [Capsule](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-capsule): An item that takes a box of blocks round the block it is used on, chests with their items too, and places it back wherever it is used next, showing a ghost first.
- [Carved block](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-carvedBlock): A block made of small pieces of any block's look, carved on its Carve tab or by players in the world.
- [Carving tool](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-carvingTool): A chisel or any tool that carves small pieces out of blocks or adds them, in one piece or a shape: a line, a flat square, a cube, a ball and more.
- [Caves](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-carver): Caves, ravines or Nether tunnels the world cuts into its ground.
- [Chemicals](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-chemicals): The chemicals kind, ready made: gases and other chemicals that tanks hold and pipes carry beside energy, fluid and items.
- [Chest](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-chest): A block that holds items and opens a screen you lay out.
- [Chest menu](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-chestMenu): A chest's screen of items, one to six rows of nine, opened by a rule for one player; each item runs its own lines when clicked, and nothing can be taken from it.
- [Code](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-code): A Java class of your own, kept safe when the mod is rebuilt.
- [Command](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-command): A command typed in chat with a slash, whose rules run when a player types it.
- [Commands to run](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-function): A list of the game's commands run together by name, when a world loads, or every tick.
- [Component](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-component): A small layout placed inside other screens as one control: a card, a row of a list, a header.
- [Condition](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-condition): A test in plain words, like half of the time, only in a biome, only at night.
- [Configurator](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-configurator): A tool that sets the faces of a placed block: right-click a face to step its mode, sneak to go back.
- [Copy wand](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-copyWand): A wand that copies the box between two corners and pastes it wherever it is used, outlining the paste first.
- [Crafter](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-crafter): Holds patterns, so the terminal can craft what they make.
- [Crafting station](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-craftingStation): A block with a 3x3 grid and a result, like a crafting table.
- [Crate](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-lootCrate): An item that opens into a loot table when used, made with its table.
- [Creative tab](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-creativeTab): A tab of the creative inventory with the things you put in it, or your things added to one of the game's tabs.
- [Crop](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-crop): A plant that grows stage by stage on farmland from its own seeds, as wheat, and gives what it grows when it is ripe.
- [Crossbow](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-crossbow): The game's own crossbow, loaded and then fired, to change.
- [Custom kind](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-matter): A matter of your own beside energy and fluid: a chemical, mana, heat, whatever your mod calls it.
- [Damage change](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-damageChange): A hurt a living thing takes, changed or cancelled by who takes it, who deals it and what it is, on every game version, without code of yours inside the game's own.
- [Damage type](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-damageType): A way of getting hurt, with its own message.
- [Dense cable](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-denseCable): A storage cable that carries 32 channels instead of 8.
- [Designator](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-designator): An item the player uses on a block to remember a place, then on an aiming block to give it that place as its target.
- [Dimension](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-dimension): A whole other world reached through a portal.
- [Dimension file of your own](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-dimensionFile): A dimension written by hand as the game's own data file, which a biome source of your own code can fill.
- [Disk for fluids](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-fluidDisk): A storage disk that holds fluids by the bucket's thousandths.
- [Drawer](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-drawer): A block that holds many of one item, shown on its front.
- [Drawing in the world](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-worldDraw): Drawn in the world from what the player looks at: an outline, the vein a key will break, a beam from the hand.
- [Drive](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-drive): A block whose slots hold storage disks.
- [Drop](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-drop): What falls out when a block breaks or a mob dies.
- [Effect](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-effect): Something that happens to a mob for a while.
- [Electric furnace](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-furnaceMachine): A machine that cooks sand into glass using energy.
- [Enchantment](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-enchantment): A power added to a tool or weapon.
- [Extras for an item](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-itemExtras): What any item, the game's or yours, also does: composts, burns in a furnace, or what a dispenser does with it.
- [Face part](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-facePart): An item placed on a face of a block that holds parts: it takes in, sends out, places, breaks, counts, shows or covers.
- [Feature](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-feature): Something the world grows as it is made: a patch of flowers, a tree, a boulder, a lake, a vein of a block.
- [File of your own](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-ownFile): Any file the mod ships as it is, under resources/: data, assets, anything the game reads.
- [Fishing rod](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-fishingRod): The game's own fishing rod: cast into water and reeled in with a catch.
- [Fluid](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-fluid): A liquid that flows in the world and fills a bucket, as water does.
- [Fluid tank](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-fluidTank): A tank that holds 8000 mB and opens its own screen.
- [Flying mount](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-flyingMount): A mount that flies with its rider, beating its wings on each jump.
- [Food](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-food): Something eaten.
- [Formed machine](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-formedMachine): A machine built of many blocks: it works only while the blocks around it stand as its pattern, drawn layer by layer on its Pattern tab, says.
- [Forms for every material](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-formSet): Makes a dust, a plate, a gear or any other form for every metal and gem the game has when it starts, other mods too.
- [Fuel](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-fuel): Something a furnace burns.
- [Game rule](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-gameRule): A rule of the world, set with the gamerule command.
- [Game thing changed](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-gameChange): One of the game's own blocks, items or mobs given new values, such as a block's hardness, an item's stack size or a mob's health, a structure the game makes no more, or a limit the game sets, such as the anvil's most cost.
- [Gene](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-gene): A trait any thing can carry and pass to its young: a number such as Growth, or one of a few choices such as Coat colour.
- [Generator](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-generator): Burns something and makes energy, on a recipe you write.
- [Generator with fuel](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-fuelGenerator): A generator that burns coal into energy, ready to run.
- [Golem-style creature](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-partsCreature): A creature built of parts and materials, as a golem is: used on a block it becomes the creature, its health, speed, armor, jobs and look its parts'.
- [Guide book](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-guideBook): A book of pages about the mod: words, pictures, items and recipes.
- [Hat](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-hat): Something worn on the head, drawn on the wearer from its own picture.
- [HUD drawing in code](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-hudDraw): Your own code that draws on the HUD every frame, in a box you place on the screen.
- [HUD layout](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-overlay): A whole screen layout you drag together: bars, words and pictures kept to a corner or an edge.
- [HUD number bar](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-hud): One number of the player shown over the game as a bar or words, like saturation above the hunger bar.
- [Item](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-item): Something held in the hand or kept in a chest.
- [Item change](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-itemChange): What happens to an item after it is made: its count, its wear, a name, a lore line, a random enchantment.
- [Item filter](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-itemFilter): A filter as an item: marked in the filter of a pipe's face, that face lets through what its rules say, items and tags, mods, wear and enchantment.
- [Item pipe](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-itemPipe): Carries items between chests and machines.
- [Key binding](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-keyBinding): A key players press to do something of yours.
- [Letter](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-letter): An item that holds a few things and is mailed to a player.
- [Link](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-storeLink): A block that joins the chests beside it to every other link in range, with no cable: a spark or a crystal.
- [Locks](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-locks): What a player may not use, wear, break, place, hit, enter or ride until they reach a skill level, a value or an advancement.
- [Look of a block made in code](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-blockLook): The blockstate, models, loot table and name a block registered in your own code needs.
- [Loot changed](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-lootChange): What the game's own blocks, mobs and chests drop, changed in place: things taken out, or one thing given in place of another.
- [Loot table](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-lootTable): A weighted list of what can come out, rolled by a quest, a crate, a mob's or a block's drop, or a rule.
- [Machine](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-machine): A block with an inventory, a tank or power.
- [Machine casing](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-machineCasing): A part of a machine built of many blocks: pipes and cables reach the machine through it, using it opens the machine's screen, and while the machine stands its state "formed" is on, so it may look different then (give that look a picture, or an empty one to hide it under the machine's own model).
- [Machine recipe](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-machineRecipe): What one machine of yours turns into something else, and what it costs.
- [Mailbox](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-mailbox): Sends letters and keeps each player's post.
- [Material](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-material): What parts are cut from, any item the game's iron ingot among them: its color, and the numbers and abilities it gives a part.
- [Matter pipe](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-matterPipe): A pipe that carries a matter of your own from the blocks that give it to the blocks that take it, holding none itself.
- [Matter tank](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-matterTank): A block that holds a matter of your own and joins pipes of it on every side: a chemical tank, a mana pool, a store of heat.
- [Mixin](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-mixin): A piece of your own code that changes one of the game's classes, listed in your mixin config for you.
- [Mixin config](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-mixinConfig): Your own mixins: notes placed inside the game's code.
- [Mob](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-creature): A living thing with a model, animations and behavior.
- [Mob behaviour](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-mobBehaviour): A piece of your own code that joins one activity of a mob's brain, the game's or another mod's.
- [Mob catcher](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-mobCatcher): An item that catches a creature with its name, health and everything it is, and lets it out again where it is used.
- [Mod settings](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-configValue): A setting players can change after the mod is built, in its config file: a number, on or off, one word out of a list, or a list of entries they edit.
- [Model](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-model): The shape of a block, item or mob, made from boxes.
- [Module](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-module): Something installed into a tool or armour that takes modules, switching an ability on and spending its energy.
- [Mount](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-mount): A mob tamed by riding it until it calms, then saddled, ridden and given bags and armour.
- [Movement](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-movement): How a living thing moves, the player or a mob: its speed and its jump, and a class of yours run as it moves.
- [Music disc](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-musicDisc): A disc that plays a song in a jukebox, the game's or your own, its words shown as it starts.
- [Network heart](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-networkHeart): The block a storage network can need to work.
- [Ore](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-ore): A block that appears in the world in veins.
- [Ore with a pickaxe](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-oreWithTier): An ore that needs an iron pickaxe, its ingot and a pickaxe.
- [Other mod's recipe](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-modRecipe): A recipe for a machine from a mod yours builds on, filled in by clicks.
- [Pack file](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-packFile): One file of a data pack or a resource pack, in any folder the game reads, yours or the game's changed.
- [Painting](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-painting): A picture hung on a wall.
- [Part](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-part): A part a tool is assembled from, cut from any material in the stonecutter, wearing its material's color.
- [Particle](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-particle): Sparks, smoke, dust and the like.
- [Pattern table](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-patternTable): Turns a blank pattern into a recipe for the crafter.
- [Pedestal](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-pedestal): A block that holds one item put on it by hand and shows it floating above it; an altar's rituals take their offerings from the pedestals around it.
- [Pet](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-pet): A mob a player tames with an item; it sits, follows and fights for them.
- [Pipe](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-pipe): Carries fluid between tanks and machines.
- [Plant](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-plant): A flower or small plant that stands on grass, as a poppy.
- [Player animation](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-playerAnimation): How a player's body moves for a moment, a wave or a bow, played on a player by a rule.
- [Pocket](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-pocket): Put into a backpack in the crafting grid, it adds nine slots.
- [Pointer](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-pointer): An item whose needle turns toward something: a transmitter on a channel, a mob you tagged, or the nearest block of a kind.
- [Potion](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-potion): A drink that gives an effect.
- [Powered armour](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-poweredArmour): A piece of armour that runs on energy: each hit its wearer takes spends some, and empty it guards nothing until it is charged.
- [Powered machine](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-poweredMachine): A machine with a recipe that uses energy and time.
- [Powered tool](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-poweredTool): A tool and weapon that runs on energy instead of wearing out: each block and each hit spends some, and empty it mines as a hand.
- [Projectile](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-projectile): A thing that flies, drawn by a model: a spell, a dart, a boomerang, a homing missile.
- [Quests](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-questBook): Chapters of quests a player finishes for rewards, read in a book of the mod's own, each quest placed on its chapter's page.
- [Receiver](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-wirelessReceiver): A block that gives out the redstone sent on its channel, by a transmitter or by a rule.
- [Recipe](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-recipe): Make something in a crafting table, furnace, stonecutter or smithing table.
- [Recipe change](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-recipeChange): Change a recipe the game or another mod already has.
- [Recipes taken away](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-recipesRemoved): Take recipes the game has out of the game.
- [Research](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-research): Studies a player researches with items, levels and time, each unlocking recipes and more.
- [Ritual](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-ritual): Offerings on pedestals around an altar, a catalyst on the altar, the conditions it asks, and the result it leaves on the altar.
- [Satellite](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-satellite): A launched thing that watches a place and reports back.
- [Scene](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-scene): A short in-game demonstration of how something works.
- [Screen](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-screen): A screen of the mod's own, laid out by dragging: opened by a rule, or shown always over the game.
- [Sea mount](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-seaMount): A swimming mob ridden under water, its rider breathing.
- [Set](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-set): Makes an ore, its ingot, tools and armor, with recipes.
- [Settings copier](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-settingsCopier): Copies one block's settings and gives them to another of the same kind.
- [Shape pattern](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-shapePattern): An item that copies the shape of a carved block and prints it again on another block.
- [Shared chest](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-sharedChest): A chest that is the same chest wherever it is placed: every shared chest on one channel holds the same items, in every world.
- [Shared tank](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-sharedTank): A tank that is the same tank wherever it is placed: every shared tank on one channel holds the same fluid, in every world, kept even while none of them is loaded.
- [Shears](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-shears): The game's own shears: they shear sheep and cut leaves, cobwebs and wool.
- [Shield](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-shield): The game's own shield, raised to stop a hit, to change.
- [Skill](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-skill): A skill with levels, like Mining or Farming: XP comes from any moment, each level reached runs its rewards, and locks may wait for a level.
- [Skill tree](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-skillTree): Skills a player buys with points, each after the ones it needs.
- [Skin](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-skin): A player's skin: the body and its picture to paint, with poses to show it in.
- [Sound](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-sound): A sound the game plays.
- [Space station](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-spaceStation): A built place in a dimension of its own that anyone or any vehicle docks with, orbiting a world at a height that rules move.
- [Species](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-species): A kind of bee, plant or animal: the gene values it starts with, what it looks like as a block, an item or a mob, and which two species bred give it.
- [Spell](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-spell): A spell of its own: what it does as rules (when it is cast, when it reaches a mob or a block, every tick it is kept up), what it costs (mana or any value), its cooldown and charge-up, and how it reaches: on the caster, along a ray, as a missile or all around.
- [Spell book](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-spellBook): An item that teaches the spells listed on it when it is used, so a wand that casts the spells a player knows can cast them.
- [Spell scroll](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-spellScroll): An item that casts its spell once and is used up.
- [Spell wand](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-spellWand): An item that casts spells: the ones listed on it, or every spell of a kit the player has learned.
- [Station recipe](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-stationRecipe): A recipe done on a station's own screen, with cells, tanks and energy.
- [Storage cable](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-storageCable): Joins cells, drawers, chests and terminals into one network.
- [Storage cell](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-storageCell): A block that holds many kinds of item, joined by cables.
- [Storage crate](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-crate): A box that keeps what it holds when broken: carry it away full.
- [Storage disk](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-storageDisk): An item that holds many kinds of item by count.
- [Structure](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-structure): A building or ruin placed in the world.
- [Structure finder](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-structureFinder): An item that finds the nearest of the structures it names and shows the way: an eye for a dungeon, a map stone for ruins.
- [Tag](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-tag): A named group of blocks or items other rules can point at.
- [Tank](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-tank): Holds a fluid and gives it to whatever asks for it.
- [Terminal](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-terminal): Lists what the network holds, to take and put by clicks.
- [Texture](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-texture): The pixels a block, item or mob wears.
- [The player](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-player): The game's own player: its body, and rules for its moments, such as when it eats, is hurt or joins.
- [Thing](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-thing): Something in the world that is not a mob and does not fly: a spell's ward, a frame on a wall, a floating orb, a balloon on a string, a trap.
- [Thrown weapon](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-thrown): Something thrown that flies as itself and hits: a throwing star, a javelin.
- [Tool](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-tool): A pickaxe, axe or shovel, or a hammer that breaks a square at once.
- [Tool for everything](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-multiTool): One tool that mines as a pickaxe, an axe, a shovel and a hoe at once.
- [Tool of parts](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-partsTool): A tool assembled from parts in the crafting grid, its numbers and abilities its materials'; a part laid beside it swaps in.
- [Tooltip lines](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-tooltip): Lines added to the tooltip of any item or block, the mod's or the game's, or of every item, each filled in from the item's numbers and values and shown by its own condition.
- [Trade station](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-tradeStation): Gives what it offers for what it wants, from its own slots.
- [Translation](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-translation): The names of your things in another language.
- [Transmitter](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-wirelessTransmitter): A block that sends the redstone reaching it on a channel, to every receiver on that channel, however far away.
- [Tree axe](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-treeAxe): An axe that fells a whole tree from one log, outlining the tree while it is aimed at.
- [Upgrade](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-upgrade): An item a player uses on a placed block that takes upgrades: it goes in and makes the block faster, bigger, quicker to move things or cheaper to run.
- [Value](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-value): A number or a list kept by an item, the player, a team or the world: Energy, XP, Kills, the foods a player has eaten.
- [Vehicle](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-vehicle): Something to ride that is not alive, beyond the boat: a cart, a motor boat, a broom or an airship, a minecart of its own, a ride along a path.
- [Vehicle part](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-vehiclePart): An item put into a vehicle by using it on it, that works there every so often: breaks the blocks ahead, harvests crops, lights the way, shoots, blows up, or what its own rules say.
- [Vein pickaxe](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-veinPickaxe): A pickaxe that mines a whole joined vein of ore from one block, outlining the vein while it is aimed at.
- [Villager job](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-villagerProfession): A job a villager takes at its workstation, with its coat and its trades.
- [Villager trade](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-villagerTrade): What a villager offers and asks for.
- [Waypoint](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-waypointBlock): A block that marks where it stands by a name, for rules to send players there: a warp stone, a home, a town's gate.
- [Waypoint compass](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-waypointCompass): An item a player marks places of their own with, lists them and travels to them, each shown on a bar along the top of the screen.
- [Weapon](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-weapon): A sword, an axe, or something new that hits.
- [When fluids meet](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-fluidReactions): What happens where a fluid meets another fluid or a block: lava meeting water makes obsidian, your own fluid meeting lava makes a block or drops an item.
- [Wireless energy node](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-wirelessNode): A block that sends the energy its cables bring on a channel, or, set to receive, gives out on its cables the energy the channel brings.
- [Wireless terminal](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-wirelessTerminal): An item that opens a terminal's screen from far away, while in its range.
- [Word of your own](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-ownWord): A few lines you name once and use in any rule as one line: it is given as many things as it needs, and it can give back an answer.
- [World event](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-worldEvent): Something that happens to a whole dimension for a while: a blood sky, a fog bank, an aurora, a rift.
- [World type](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-worldType): A choice on the game's Create New World screen.
- [Worn slots](https://modryos.com/docs/thing-wornSlots): Slots you name on any mob, the game's own or yours: a hat on a cow, boots on its four legs, a saddle on a pig, armor on a wolf.
- [Mod project](https://modryos.com/docs/project-mod): Blocks, items, recipes and everything else, built for NeoForge and Fabric.
- [Data pack project](https://modryos.com/docs/project-datapack): Recipes, drops, tags and world data with no code, for a plain game.
- [Resource pack project](https://modryos.com/docs/project-resourcepack): Textures, models, sounds and translations for the game's own things.
- [Modpack project](https://modryos.com/docs/project-modpack): A collection of published mods, yours and other people's, ready to install.
- [Extension project](https://modryos.com/docs/project-extension): New kinds of things, or a new game version, for Modryos itself.
- [Templates and samples](https://modryos.com/docs/templates-and-samples): Ready-made starting points: templates add one thing that works, samples are small finished mods.
- [Versions and loaders](https://modryos.com/docs/versions-and-loaders): The game versions and loaders Modryos makes mods for, and what one project can target at once.
- [Troubleshooting](https://modryos.com/docs/troubleshooting): The plain-English messages Modryos can show, when each one shows and how to fix it.
- [Glossary](https://modryos.com/docs/glossary): The studio's own words, each in one line.

All docs in one file: https://modryos.com/llms-full.txt
<!-- docs:end -->
